title: Mediopassive Destruction: elpusztul, romba dől, felég

sections.content: Describing devastating historical events often focuses on the fate of buildings, settlements, and populations without actively naming the destroyer. Hungarian expresses this with mediopassive verbs and intransitive idioms: *elpusztul* (perishes / is wiped out), *romba dől* (falls into ruins / collapses), and *felég* (burns down completely).

items.spanish: A virágzó falvak százai égtek fel a harcok alatt.
items.english: Hundreds of prosperous villages burned down during the fighting.

items.spanish: Az ország szinte teljes területe romba dőlt egy év alatt.
items.english: Almost the entire territory of the country collapsed into ruins in one year.

items.spanish: A lakosság jelentős része elpusztult vagy fogságba esett.
items.english: A significant part of the population perished or was taken captive.

sections.content: Compare active vs. mediopassive: *A tatárok felégették a várost* (The Tatars burned down the town - active) vs. *A város felégett* (The town burned down - mediopassive focus).
